tagline: 尼康胶片单反相机，1994 年发布
description: 尼康于1994年推出的胶片单反相机。配备kit lenses AF Nikkor 35-80mm f/4-5.6 D and AF Nikkor 80-200mm f/4.5-5.6D.。快门速度Electronically controlled vertical-travel focal-plane shutter; 1/2000 sec. to 30 sec.。使用24 x 36mm standard 35mm (135) film format。感光度ISO 25 to 5000 for DX coded film; ISO 6 to 6400 for non-DXcoded films in Advanced mode。Auto Focus / Manual Focus。

specs.镜头: kit lenses AF Nikkor 35-80mm f/4-5.6 D and AF Nikkor 80-200mm f/4.5-5.6D.
specs.快门: Electronically controlled vertical-travel focal-plane shutter; 1/2000 sec. to 30 sec.
specs.感光度: ISO 25 to 5000 for DX coded film; ISO 6 to 6400 for non-DXcoded films in Advanced mode
specs.电池: 6V lithium battery pack (2CR5 or DL245 type)
specs.英文简介:
__NOTOC__

The F50, sold as the N50 in the United States, was an entry-level 35mm film Single-lens reflex camera which was introduced by Nikon in 1994.
